**Restrict `xms_edov` to Microsoft Entra ID.**

The fallback runs for every non-GitHub and non-SAML strategy, including generic OIDC and Google. If a non-Entra OIDC provider returns `xms_edov: true` without `email_verified`, the verifier marks the email as verified. Mobile and web onboarding then use that result for JIT account creation and invitation redemption.

Gate `xms_edov` on the configured Microsoft Entra issuer. Keep the existing `email_verified` handling unchanged.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh DB-backed email-trust settings before verification**

For a DB-backed provider, changing this toggle in `/admin/sso_providers` updates the row and only clears `ProviderLoader`'s cache (`Admin::SsoProvidersController#clear_provider_cache`); the array read here was populated once by `config/initializers/omniauth.rb` and is never refreshed in the running process. As a result, enabling the toggle does not unblock JIT until every app process restarts, while disabling an unsafe toggle keeps unverified account or invitation trust active despite `docs/hosting/oidc.md:341-344` promising immediate changes; read the live DB config in DB mode or update the runtime registry.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L8-L8](https://github.com/we-promise/sure/blob/0e094724b009974348ef1ffac03f8a121dac3f8e/AGENTS.md#L8-L8)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use the validated Entra ID-token claim**

With Microsoft Entra configured exactly as `docs/hosting/oidc.md:469` directs (add `xms_edov` to the ID token), `omniauth_openid_connect` puts the UserInfo response in `auth.extra.raw_info`, and Entra's UserInfo response does not echo optional ID-token claims. This lookup therefore never sees `xms_edov`, so JIT and invitation flows remain blocked unless the broader provider-wide opt-in is used; consume the strategy's already-validated ID-token claim rather than only `raw_info`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Record unverified JIT attempts before hiding creation**

For a new web SSO identity whose email has no existing user and would otherwise qualify for JIT, this branch sets `@allow_account_creation` false, and `app/views/oidc_accounts/link.html.erb:53-66` removes the only create POST. `log_jit_blocked!` runs only inside `create_user`, so an ordinary blocked login produces no audit event (the mobile path has the same shape), causing the `jit_blocked` diagnostic recommended in `docs/hosting/oidc.md:467-473` to miss these attempts; record the rejection once at the callback or gating point.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Surface the unverified-email reason in mobile onboarding**

For a new or invited mobile user with an unverified email, this now returns `account_not_linked` with both creation flags false but sends no rejection reason. `mobile/lib/services/auth_service.dart:423-433` maps that callback only to linking fields and `mobile/lib/screens/sso_onboarding_screen.dart:135-173` consequently shows only the existing-account link form, so the promised “IdP did not confirm your email” explanation is never visible (the API error cannot be reached because the create tab is hidden); propagate a reason that the onboarding screen can render.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Localize the new mobile-facing rejection**

If this endpoint is called directly or by a client with stale onboarding state, this value is displayed verbatim by `mobile/lib/providers/auth_provider.dart:512-520`, so non-English users receive a newly hardcoded English message. Move it to the locale files and return `t(...)`, as the web rejection path does, so the user-facing error follows the repository's localization requirement.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L29-L31](https://github.com/we-promise/sure/blob/0e094724b009974348ef1ffac03f8a121dac3f8e/AGENTS.md#L29-L31)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document the verified-email prerequisite in the API**

For calls to `/api/v1/auth/sso_create_account` whose linking code has `email_verified` missing or false, this adds a distinct 403 prerequisite, but `spec/requests/api/v1/auth_spec.rb:321-324,368-370` and generated `docs/api/openapi.yaml:5073-5078,5129-5134` still document only `allow_account_creation` and removed-or-disabled cases. Update the documentation-only rswag description/response and regenerate OpenAPI so API consumers understand this expected rejection.
